description: Distill a reusable voice from an existing WhatsApp conversation's stored messages — no extension needed. `author` picks whose voice: 'me' (owner's own outgoing texts), 'contact' (the other party), 'bot', or 'any'. For a group chat, pass senderName/senderPhone to isolate one participant. Requires >=3 usable text messages. Runs an LLM call.

limit.description: How many recent messages to read (default 200).

senderName.description: For groups: match one participant by display name.

senderPhone.description: For groups: match one participant by phone.

name: neuron_build_persona_from_conversation
title: Build Persona from WhatsApp Chat
